title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts the Boston Red Sox will make the playoffs despite their strong performance since July.
The Red Sox, 64-52, hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 96% playoff chance per FanGraphs.
Brian Kenny disagrees with Parker, asserting the Red Sox are likely playoff contenders after recent winning streaks.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Red Sox's Wilyer Abreu was scratched from Saturday's lineup due to swelling in his leg.
Chad Tracy expressed hope Abreu will return for Sunday's game after evaluating his condition.
Abreu ranks second in home runs and RBIs for Boston, with a .256 average and .793 OPS in 2026.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs in 5.1 innings, contributing to the Red Sox's sixth loss in 38 games.
The Red Sox maintain the American League's second wild-card spot, trailing the Yankees by 1.5 games.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf due to an NFL policy requiring approved lab testing for surfaces without an 'E-layer'.
The turf surface installed post-World Cup was not compliant with NFL testing protocols due to missing a spring testing window.
Kraft Sports Group's request for an NFL test was denied, leading to the installation of a previously used 2025 turf version.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium on Saturday.
Jack Harrison made his club debut for New England but couldn't impact the short-term game outcome.
Houston's goals came from Guilherme and Agustin Resch, exploiting New England's defensive lapses.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been out since May with a wrist injury and is hitting off a pitching machine.
Adley Rutschman made a five-inning rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching and showing defensive skills.
Connor Wong has exceeded expectations at catcher while Rutschman prepares for his Red Sox debut post-trade deadline.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: "Clueless" (1995) and "Eighth Grade" (2018) are highlighted as top Netflix picks for August.
"Something’s Gotta Give" (2003) is recommended across Netflix, Hulu, and Tubi for its performances and set design.
New releases include "Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender" (2026) on Paramount+ and "The Ballad of Wallis Island" (2025) on Peacock.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an encounter with an 8-foot Bigfoot in Voluntown, Connecticut on July 5.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has verified 126 sightings in New England since 1994.
Boston University experts remain skeptical, citing lack of scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of advice columnist Ann Landers, died last month at the age of 86.
Howard, who wrote 'Dear Prudence' and 'Dear Margo,' was known for her practical and sarcastic advice.
Writer Meredith Goldstein reflects on Howard's influence, appreciating her encouragement to balance grief with joy.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox win 13-1 against Athletics, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Payton Tolle strikes out a career-high 14 batters, allowing only two hits in six innings.
Boston's offense contributes with 15 hits and multiple high-scoring innings against Athletics.
